messages:
sophie: CI is red on main — a bunch of ml-inference integration tests failing with 500s from the mock KV cache. job: https://ci.redwood.internal/12345
raj: seeing same when I run `make test-integ` locally. logs show repeated `MockKVCache: 500 Internal` during test setup
ci-bot: build #12345 failed: integration-tests (ml-inference) — see logs at https://ci.redwood.internal/12345/logs
maria: which tests are failing exactly?
sophie: `inference/cache_eviction_test` and `prompt_prefix_cache_integration` consistently
leo: I just SSH'd into the CI runner and tail'd the mock container — it's returning 500 on healthcheck for ~30s after start
raj: that smells like a bad image push or a new startup race
sophie: I bisected locally — last green was `a1b2c3d` and the first bad commit is `f4e5g6h` which bumped the mock-kvcache image tag
maria: image tag? can you paste it?
sophie: the failing tag is `redwood/mock-kvcache:2026-03-09-rc2`
leo: workaround options: 1) pin CI compose to previous tag; 2) add a startup delay/healthcheck retry in CI; 3) revert the image bump PR
raj: I'd prefer pinning in CI until the mock image is fixed. masking with retries hides the problem
sophie: agreed. @eng-infra can we pin test compose for the nightly/integration runners?
leo: I can open a quick CI override PR to pin `redwood/mock-kvcache:2026-02-25` for the integration job
maria: sounds good — please do and assign to @sophie for quick review
ci-bot: job re-run #12346 started (triggered by leo)
raj: note: when I ran a local reproducible loop I got intermittent 500s during cold start. adding deterministic startup in the mock would help debugging
sophie: leo — paste the PR link once created. I'll review asap and merge if green
leo: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/eng/ci-configs/pulls/789 — pins mock-kvcache and adds an extra healthcheck-retry env in the job
maria: also recording this for follow-up: add a lightweight smoke test for mock images before promoting to integration tag
sophie: agreed. after PR merges, I'll restart the failed pipeline and monitor. thanks for the quick triage everyone :thumbsup:
raj: if it still flakes after pin, we can bisect deeper into the mock image change set and roll back specific commits
sophie: update: PR merged, CI re-run in progress (see ci-bot). will post final status in this thread
ci-bot: build #12346 succeeded: integration-tests (ml-inference) — all tests passed
sophie: great, closing the loop. we'll follow up with a short postmortem note and action item to harden mock image promotion process
